ai_chat_provider.description: Active chat provider. Values: MISTRAL | GEMINI | OPENAI | CLAUDE

ai_chat_model.description: Chat model override. Empty = use provider built-in default. Example: mistral-medium-latest | gemini-2.5-flash | gpt-4o-mini

ai_memory_provider.description: Provider used for memory extraction, summarization, and planning. Values: MISTRAL | GEMINI | OPENAI | CLAUDE

ai_memory_model.description: Model for memory pipeline (extraction, summarizer, planner). Current live models: gemini-2.5-flash-lite (cheap) | gemini-2.5-flash (standard)

ai_kill_switch.description: Set true to disable ALL AI calls app-wide. Emergency brake — no app update needed.

ai_smart_mode_default.description: Default value for smart mode (memory + task context injection) on first install.

version.description: Initial AI config — Gemini 2.5 models, Mistral chat default
